scenarios.name: Direct answer without Socratic friction
scenarios.userMessage: Quick gut check: is a deterministic workflow usually safer than a free-form agent for a refund process?

scenarios.name: Explain missing foundation
scenarios.userMessage: I keep hearing that context windows are memory. I do not really understand the difference.
expectedSignals: Does not assume jargon implies understanding
Uses at most one follow-up question

scenarios.name: Preserve correct reasoning and challenge one gap
scenarios.userMessage: My agent is reliable because temperature is zero, so its tool calls should always be deterministic even when the prompt and retrieved documents change.
expectedSignals: Mentions changing context or provider behavior

scenarios.name: Avoid pedantic challenge
scenarios.userMessage: For this small internal form, I would start with validation and an audit log before adding an autonomous recovery agent because failures need to be reviewable.
expectedSignals: Acknowledges that the reasoning fits the goal

scenarios.name: Test transfer without revealing the answer
scenarios.userMessage: I think I understand balancing and reinforcing feedback loops. Give me a fresh product example to test myself.
expectedSignals: Does not reveal the classification or solution

scenarios.name: Qualify empirical claims
scenarios.userMessage: How much will removing account creation increase checkout conversion?
expectedSignals: Separates general friction guidance from measured lift

scenarios.name: Give an operational recommendation
scenarios.userMessage: I have two hours. Should I add another agent or write three regression tests for the current one?

scenarios.name: Clarify only the consequential ambiguity
scenarios.userMessage: Our agent is slow and I want to fix the model.
expectedSignals: Clarifies whether slow means turn detection, model generation, or speech
Does not prematurely prescribe a model
